visual_observations.observation: A man wearing a blue surgical cap, a black jacket, and a stethoscope around his neck is sitting in a car, looking directly at the camera. On-screen text is overlaid.

visible_text.text: In your 20s you'll get HORRIBLE acid reflux and someone will tell you to sleep on your left side, raise the head of your bed, take slow deep breaths after eating, take only small sips of water with meals, eat 5g of psyllium before meals, go for a walk after eating, chew gum, and wait 3 hours before lying down. It's very important that you listen.

hook_evidence.evidence: The on-screen text immediately presents a relatable problem: 'In your 20s you'll get HORRIBLE acid reflux'.
